notes: ROLLED BACK 2026-08-03: v1.1.4 was published from a tag that did NOT contain the bench-tested fix 'a fresh PENDING_VERIFY image is not a crash boot'. Without it, a device updating from 1.0.6 counts its own successful OTA reboot as a crash. The binary below is deliberately LEFT AS IS so a cached manifest can never be paired with a different binary; only the version is reverted, which stops any further install because update.c installs strictly newer versions only. A corrected 1.1.5 follows.
